title: Upgrading Programme to Replace Lifts in HDB Estates
what_it_is: Upgrading Programme to Replace Lifts in HDB Estates

sections.label: HDB lift replacement question
sections.summary: Asked whether HDB will consider a new upgrading programme to replace old lifts in HDB estates with frequent breakdowns.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for National Development whether HDB will consider implementing a new upgrading programme to replace old lifts in HDB estates that are experiencing 	Page: 23 frequent breakdowns.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, the duty of the TCs includes the replacement of lifts when they are due, as well as the monitoring and cyclical maintenance to ensure serviceability and to prevent frequent lift breakdowns.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, since 2001, the Government has spent $5 billion under the Lift Upgrading Programme (LUP) to improve lift accessibility for 5,000 HDB blocks without direct lift access.

sections.label: Selective Lift Replacement Programme
sections.summary: In September 2014 HDB introduced the SLRP to replace about 750 old lifts with modern lifts for some 33,000 households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In September 2014, HDB introduced the Selective Lift Replacement Programme (SLRP).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This was to replace about 750 old lifts with modern lifts that come with better safety and security features.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: These new lift features, which will benefit some 33,000 households, include energy-efficient motors, vision panels and doors with infra-red motion sensors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB is working closely with the TCs to implement the SLRP on a cost-sharing basis and we will monitor the outcomes of this programme before deciding on our next steps.

sections.label: Lifts covered under LUP
sections.summary: More than 55% of lifts are covered under the LUP, and the remaining about 10,000 lifts' oldest batch is covered under the SLRP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: More than 55% of them are already covered under the LUP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, for the remaining lifts that are not covered under LUP, which are about 10,000, the oldest batch is the ones covered under the SLRP.

sections.label: Lift installation time criterion
sections.summary: The key criterion is the time lifts were installed, and the selected batch was from the period 1987 to 1997.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Perhaps, within an estate, you may have lifts installed at different times.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: They may also be lifts which do not have vision panels but I think the key criterion is the time in which they were installed and we have selected this particular batch which was the 	Page: 24 batch during the period of 1987 to 1997.
